reviews.title: Good vibes
reviews.text: I enjoy the spartan era vibes and the motivational messages. I also like the leaderboard aspect. It feels more real when you are competing against others. What I didn’t like is that the habits themselves cannot be fully customizable. I have certain habits that I want to add that are not available. Therefore I did not subscribe. If the dev team can add this feature I may reconsider.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Having been using this app for almost a week now and love it. Really helpful for breaking down not just daily habits, but why they are helpful. Found myself today doing some of the things before even opening the app today, didn’t expect habits to be forming that quickly. Definitely recommend for anyone trying to find a little more clarity in their day.
